description_en: Submits a media information analysis job. After you call this operation, ApsaraVideo Media Processing (MPS) analyzes the media information of the input file and returns the results
description_zh: 提交媒体信息作业。调用本接口之后媒体处理MPS会对输入文件进行媒体信息分析，返回输入文件的媒体信息
kebab_example: aliyun mts submit-media-info-job --input '{"Bucket":"example-bucket","Location":"example-location","Object":"example%2Fexample.flv"}' --user-data testid-001 --pipeline-id 88c6ca184c0e432bbf5b665e2a150000 --async true --config example-string --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitMediaInfoJob

parameters.help_en:
Job input. For more information, see [Input details](~~29253#section-f3p-d24-y2b~~).

In MPS APIs, the Object value must be URL encoded using UTF-8.

The region of the OSS bucket must match the region where MPS is deployed
parameters.help_zh:
作业输入。详细说明请参见[Input详情](~~29253#section-f3p-d24-y2b~~)。

在媒体处理API中，Object必须经过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html（基于UTF-8编码）后使用。
OSS的地域需要与当前MPS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: User-defined data. You can use letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It cannot start with a special character. Maximum length: 1024 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据。可以使用中英文、数字、中划线（-）等，不能以特殊符号开头，最大长度1024个字节
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
Pipeline ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29197.html.

You can find or create pipelines in the MPS console (https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview)>Settings>Pipelines.

To receive asynchronous notifications, attach an MNS topic to the pipeline. For more information, see <props="china">Receive message notifications (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42618.html)</props> and <props="intl">Receive message notifications (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mps/receive-message-notifications/?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.0.b48576d2jxNSca)</props>
parameters.help_zh:
管道ID。详细信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29197.html。
可选值：可以通过MPS控制台 (https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview)>全局设置>管道查询和创建。
如果需要异步通知，请为管道绑定MNS消息，具体请参见<props="china">接收消息通知 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42618.html)</props><props="intl">接收消息通知 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mps/receive-message-notifications/?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.0.b48576d2jxNSca)</props>
parameters.name: pipeline_id

parameters.help_en:
Specify whether to run the job asynchronously. Valid values:

true: Run the job asynchronously. We recommend this option.

false: Run the job synchronously
parameters.help_zh:
是否发起异步作业。取值：

true：发起异步作业（推荐）。
false：不发起异步作业
parameters.name: async
